user.title: Connect to Motifini
user.description: Enter the address of the Motifini webserver. Enable it in motifini.conf under [webserver] first.

data_description.host: Hostname or IP of the machine running Motifini.
data_description.api_key: Must match api_key in motifini.conf when one is set there. Usually required when Motifini listens on a non-localhost address.
data_description.path_prefix: Only when behind a reverse proxy path, e.g. motifini. Usually blank.
